lines.en: Eva, be careful with that bowl. The soup was so hot that I could not eat it for ten minutes.
lines.pt: Eva, cuidado com essa tigela. A sopa estava tão quente que não consegui comer por dez minutos.

lines.en: Thanks, Cal. This place is so popular that I waited forty minutes for a table last Saturday.
lines.pt: Obrigada, Cal. Este lugar é tão popular que esperei quarenta minutos por uma mesa no último sábado.

lines.en: Really? The waiter walked so slowly that I thought he was angry with us.
lines.pt: Sério? O garçom andava tão devagar que achei que estava bravo com a gente.

lines.en: Maybe he was tired. I was so hungry that I almost ate the bread basket before the food arrived.
lines.pt: Talvez estivesse cansado. Eu estava com tanta fome que quase comi a cesta de pão antes de a comida chegar.

lines.en: Ha! My morning was worse. I was so late that I left home without my keys and my phone.
lines.pt: Ha! Minha manhã foi pior. Cheguei tão atrasado que saí de casa sem as chaves e sem o celular.

lines.en: That is awful. How did you get into the office? The security guard is so strict that he never lets anybody in.
lines.pt: Que horror. Como você entrou no escritório? O segurança é tão rígido que nunca deixa ninguém entrar.

lines.en: I called my colleague, who came downstairs. There was so much traffic that I thought I would never arrive.
lines.pt: Liguei para o meu colega, que desceu. Havia tanto trânsito que achei que nunca chegaria.

lines.en: Poor you. Today the coffee is so bad that I have decided to bring my own thermos tomorrow.
lines.pt: Coitado. Hoje o café está tão ruim que decidi trazer minha própria garrafa térmica amanhã.

lines.en: Good idea. The prices here have gone up so quickly that I now eat lunch at home twice a week.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Os preços aqui subiram tão rápido que agora almoço em casa duas vezes por semana.

lines.en: Me too. Still, the apple pie is so delicious that I never skip it, even when I am saving money.
lines.pt: Eu também. Mesmo assim, a torta de maçã é tão delicioso que nunca deixo de comê-lo, mesmo economizando.

lines.en: Then let us share one. I am so full that I cannot finish a whole slice alone.
lines.pt: Então vamos dividir uma. Estou tão cheio que não consigo comer uma fatia inteira sozinho.

facts.label: Consequências do dia
facts.sub: so hot that…, so slowly that…, so much traffic that…, so many people that…

facts.label: so slowly that
facts.sub: Com verbos, use advérbio: He walked so slowly that I got angry. Compare com o adjetivo: He was so slow. O advérbio descreve a ação.

facts.label: so much, so many
facts.sub: Use so much com incontáveis e so many com contáveis: so much traffic, so many people. Em seguida, venha o that: There was so much traffic that I was late.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: So hot that I could not eat it shows a result.
We use so before a noun: so soup.
items.why: Use such soup or so much soup.

items.s: So many is used with countable nouns.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: So hot that I could not eat it shows a result. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We use so before a noun: so soup. → Falso (Use such soup or so much soup.)
So many is used with countable nouns. → Verdadeiro (Yes: so many people.)

pages.title: A hard day at lunch · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy lunchtime in Atlanta. Cal and Eva sit at a small table. The cafe smells of coffee and fresh bread. A waiter brings two bowls of soup. Steam rises from the table. Both friends start to talk about their day.

“Eva, be careful with that bowl. The soup was so hot that I could not eat it for ten minutes.” says Cal. “Thanks, Cal. This place is so popular that I waited forty minutes for a table last Saturday.” says Eva. “Really? The waiter walked so slowly that I thought he was angry with us.” says Cal.
